Subject: Gym direct debit taken TWICE after I cancelled it

Hi there,

I cancelled my direct debit to Corefield Fitness in your app on the evening of Friday 2nd October. The app showed it as cancelled straight away and I have a screenshot. Despite that, £42.99 went out on Monday 5th and then ANOTHER £42.99 on the 12th. The gym says I'm 'still in my notice period' and that it's between me and my bank.

I cancelled the membership with them by email on 30/09 as well. I don't see how you can let a company take money when the direct debit isn't there any more. I'd like both payments (£85.98) put back in my account and confirmation they can't take anything else.

You can reach me on [PHONE_1] if easier, I'm not always near my landline.

Thanks
[CUSTOMER]

[CUSTOMER]
Sort code [SORT_CODE]

CA [ACCOUNT]. DDI ref CFL-00418823 originator COREFIELD FITNESS LTD SUN 448120. 02/10/2026 23:48 DDI CANCELLED via mobile app. AUDDIS 0C advice sent 05/10/2026. 05/10/2026 DD paid GBP 42.99 COREFIELD FITNESS (BACS input 01/10/2026, collection already in cycle at cancellation). 12/10/2026 DD paid GBP 42.99 COREFIELD FITNESS ref 'FINAL MONTH NOTICE' - DDI status at presentation: CANCELLED. Not rejected. Exception code DD-NR-07 (cancelled mandate reject rule not applied).

[CUSTOMER] - 2 x £42.99 gym DDs after she cancelled DDI in app 02/10. 2nd one (12/10) should have bounced, CORE shows reject rule failed. 1st one maybe already in BACS cycle. Is this a DD Guarantee indemnity claim or unauth payment under PSRs (15 day clock)? Prob both for diff payments. Asked [STAFF_2] to confirm which clock. Emailed cust 15/10 asking for copy of gym cancellation email, no reply yet. Sending to Payments & Disputes. - [STAFF_1]
